notes.title: Hotfix 6
notes.content:
-Fixed bug where you can open the pause menu while playing minigames
-Fixed bug where if you die while inside a cabinet the game breaks

we know lots of other bugs still exist and we appreciate any bug reports you guys give us!
if you've discovered a bug let us know about it in the [b]bug reports[/b] channel on our discord  https://discord.gg/u8AMDMfDS9

Have fun getting pantsed!!!

                [i] -The Dunderheads Dev Team[/i]
